# EMTA APA TSD fixtures

These small public examples are vendored for offline structural tests. Source share: `Andmepohine_TSD_2026` on `ncfailid.emta.ee`. Retrieved 2026-10-28.

Files are the 2025-10-17 business example and cancellation example, the 2026-03-30 feedback report XSD, and all four 2026-03-30 feedback report examples. They are unmodified source files. No live EMTA calls are made by the test suite.
